strengths: Room-by-room heat, kotatsu vs hallway, heated seat vs cold tile, open shop door on ankles—locals would say yes.
Peeling a pack off in an overheated office is a real complaint.
Variation (run hot, hate adhesive, mild prefectures) is adult, not a national personality.

issues.location: How Winter Feels — “sokubi (足先) — fingertips and toes”
issues.problem: Wrong word and wrong gloss. 足先 is ashisaki (tips of the feet), not sokubi. Fingertips are 手先 (tesaki). Locals say 手先・足先が冷たい.
issues.suggestion: Replace with tesaki and ashisaki (手先・足先), fingertips and toes.
